entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
None has appeared for the informant.

2. This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in S. T. No. 898 of 2022, arising out case crime No. 411 of 2022, under Sections-498A, 304B IPC and Sections-3 / 4 of D. P. Act, police station Kotwali Shahar, District Bijnor, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is husband of the deceased.
The marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place about two years prior to the incident and out of that marriage, they have one child.

The allegation of dowry demand and harassment of deceased levelled Shahvez vs State Of U.P. on 31 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163443739/
1 against the accused persons, including the applicant, are wholly false.
In the first information report merely a vague allegation has been made that deceased was being harassed on account of dowry.
It was submitted that on the occasion of Eid, deceased was insisting to visit her parental home and as she could not go there, she committed suicide in a fit of rage.
In post mortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on the body of deceased and cause of death has been shown as ante mortem hanging.

It is further submitted that the applicant is in jail since 1.7.2022 and thus,
he has already undergone the detention of one year and eleven months but during trial only one witness has been examined and thus, trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
It was submitted that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is husband of deceased, who has suffered unnatural death within seven years of her marriage.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Shahvez involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
I. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
Iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 31.5.2024 HR  Shahvez vs State Of U.P. on 31 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163443739/
2
